verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਸ ਪਰਸ ਦਰਸ ਕਤ ਸਜਨੀ ਕਤ ਵੈ ਨੈਨ ਬੈਨ ਮਨ ਮੋਹਨ ॥
verses.translit_en: paaras paras dharas kat sajanee kat vai nain bain man mohan ||

en.bdb: O my Guru-conscious friend! like a philosopher-stone, the touch of which changes a metal into gold, where is the glimpse of the True Guru that makes a person supreme and valuable like gold? Where are those enamoring eyes and sweet invaluable words?

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਤ ਵੈ ਦਸਨ ਹਸਨ ਸੋਭਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਕਤ ਵੈ ਗਵਨ ਭਵਨ ਬਨ ਸੋਹਨ ॥
verses.translit_en: kat vai dhasan hasan sobhaa nidh kat vai gavan bhavan ban sohan ||

en.bdb: Where is that smiling face with beautiful teeth, where is the hearth and home and his majestic walk in the fields and gardens?

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਤ ਵੈ ਰਾਗ ਰੰਗ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਕਤ ਵੈ ਦਇਆ ਮਇਆ ਦੁਖ ਜੋਹਨ ॥
verses.translit_en: kat vai raag ra(n)g sukh saagar kat vai dhiaa miaa dhukh johan ||

en.bdb: Where is the treasure of peace and comfort? The treasure of singing His praises through Naam and bani (Guru's compositions). Where is that look of kindness and benevolence that is sailing myriad devotees across the worldly ocean?

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਤ ਵੈ ਜੋਗ ਭੋਗ ਰਸ ਲੀਲਾ ਕਤ ਵੈ ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਛਬਿ ਗੋਹਨ ॥੪੦੦॥
verses.translit_en: kat vai jog bhog ras leelaa kat vai sa(n)t sabhaa chhab gohan ||400||

en.bdb: Where is the engrossment, strange and wondrous feeling, of enjoying the bliss of the Lord? Where is the assembly of saints in the True Guru's divine presence that sings the praises of the mighty Lord and creates a celestial image of His Court? (400)
